}

 if (a.hi != null) { if (b.lo != null) finite.add(a.hi.multiply(b.lo)); if (b.hi != null) finite.add(a.hi.multiply(b.hi)); }

 return of(lo, hi);

static Map<String, Interval> propagateBox(List<Ineq> constraints) {
 Map<String, Interval> box = new HashMap<>();
 for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; iter++) {
   boolean changed = false;
   for (Ineq ineq : constraints) {
     LinearExpr expr = ineq.expr();
     Interval exprInt = expr.toInterval(box);
     if (exprInt.empty) return null;
     if (exprInt.lo != null && exprInt.lo.compareTo(ineq.bound()) > 0) return null;
     for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : expr.coeffs().entrySet()) {
       String var = e.getKey();
       BigInteger a = e.getValue();
       if (a.signum() == 0) continue;
       LinearExpr rest = expr.sub(LinearExpr.ofVar(var).mul(a));
       Interval restInt = rest.toInterval(box);
       if (restInt.empty) return null;
       Interval varInt = box.getOrDefault(var, Interval.TOP);
       BigInteger newLo = varInt.lo;
       BigInteger newHi = varInt.hi;
       if (restInt.lo != null) {
         BigInteger k = ineq.bound().subtract(restInt.lo);
         if (a.signum() > 0) {
           BigInteger b = floorDiv(k, a);
           if (newHi == null || b.compareTo(newHi) < 0) newHi = b;
         } else {
           BigInteger b = ceilDiv(k, a);
           if (newLo == null || b.compareTo(newLo) > 0) newLo = b;
         }
       }
       Interval candidate = Interval.of(newLo, newHi);
       Interval updated = varInt.intersect(candidate);
       if (updated.empty) return null;
       if (!updated.equals(varInt)) { box.put(var, updated); changed = true; }
     }
   }
   if (!changed) break;
 }
 return box;
}

static boolean fmFeasible(List<Ineq> constraints) {
 TreeSet<String> vars = new TreeSet<>();
 for (Ineq ineq : constraints) vars.addAll(ineq.expr().coeffs().keySet());
 int n = vars.size();
 if (n > FM_VAR_LIMIT) return true;
 List<String> varList = new ArrayList<>(vars);
 Map<String, Integer> index = new HashMap<>();
 for (int i=0;i<n;i++) index.put(varList.get(i), i);
 List<FmIneq> list = new ArrayList<>();
 for (Ineq ineq : constraints) {
   BigInteger[] coeffs = new BigInteger[n];
   Arrays.fill(coeffs, ZERO);
   for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : ineq.expr().coeffs().entrySet()) {
     Integer idx = index.get(e.getKey());
     if (idx != null) coeffs[idx] = e.getValue();
   }
   FmIneq norm = normalizeFm(coeffs, ineq.bound());
   if (norm == INFEASIBLE) return false;
   if (norm != null) list.add(norm);
 }
 if (list.isEmpty()) return true;
 for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
   List<FmIneq> zero = new ArrayList<>();
   List<FmIneq> pos = new ArrayList<>();
   List<FmIneq> neg = new ArrayList<>();
   for (FmIneq ineq : list) {
     BigInteger c = ineq.coeffs[i];
     if (c.signum() > 0) pos.add(ineq);
     else if (c.signum() < 0) neg.add(ineq);
     else zero.add(ineq);
   }
   List<FmIneq> next = new ArrayList<>(zero);
   if (!pos.isEmpty() && !neg.isEmpty()) {
     long pairs = (long) pos.size() * (long) neg.size();
     if (pairs > FM_PAIR_LIMIT) return true;
     for (FmIneq p : pos) {
       for (FmIneq q : neg) {
         BigInteger multP = q.coeffs[i].negate();
         BigInteger multQ = p.coeffs[i];
         BigInteger[] newCoeffs = new BigInteger[n];
         Arrays.fill(newCoeffs, ZERO);
         for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
           if (j == i) continue;
           newCoeffs[j] = p.coeffs[j].multiply(multP).add(q.coeffs[j].multiply(multQ));
         }
         BigInteger newBound = p.bound.multiply(multP).add(q.bound.multiply(multQ));
         FmIneq norm = normalizeFm(newCoeffs, newBound);
         if (norm == INFEASIBLE) return false;
         if (norm != null) {
           next.add(norm);
           if (next.size() > FM_INEQ_LIMIT) return true;
         }
       }
     }
   }
   list = next;
   if (list.size() > FM_INEQ_LIMIT) return true;
 }
 for (FmIneq ineq : list) {
   for (BigInteger c : ineq.coeffs) {
     if (c.signum() != 0) return true;
   }
   if (ineq.bound.signum() < 0) return false;
 }
 return true;
}

static FmIneq normalizeFm(BigInteger[] coeffs, BigInteger bound) {
 int first = -1;
 for (int i=0;i<coeffs.length;i++) if (coeffs[i].signum()!=0) { first=i; break; }
 if (first == -1) {
   if (bound.signum() < 0) return INFEASIBLE;
   return null;
 }
 BigInteger g = ZERO;
 for (BigInteger c : coeffs) if (c.signum()!=0) g = g.gcd(c.abs());
 g = g.gcd(bound.abs());
 if (g.signum() > 1 && bound.mod(g).equals(ZERO)) {
   for (int i=0;i<coeffs.length;i++) if (coeffs[i].signum()!=0) coeffs[i] = coeffs[i].divide(g);
   bound = bound.divide(g);
 }
 return new FmIneq(coeffs, bound);
}

static LinearExpr linear(RVal r) {
 return switch (r) {
  case RVal.IntConst c -> LinearExpr.ofConst(c.v());
  case LVal.Local l -> LinearExpr.ofVar(l.name());
  case LVal.StaticField f -> {
    BigInteger v = staticConst(f);
    yield v == null ? null : LinearExpr.ofConst(v);
  }
  case RVal.Binop b -> {
    switch (b.op()) {
      case Mult -> {
        BigInteger lc = constant(b.l());
        if (lc != null && lc.signum() == 0) yield LinearExpr.ofConst(ZERO);
        BigInteger rc = constant(b.r());
        if (rc != null && rc.signum() == 0) yield LinearExpr.ofConst(ZERO);
        LinearExpr l = linear(b.l());
        LinearExpr rr = linear(b.r());
        if (l == null || rr == null) yield null;
        if (l.isConst()) yield rr.mul(l.constant());
        if (rr.isConst()) yield l.mul(rr.constant());
        yield null;
      }
      case Add -> {
        LinearExpr l = linear(b.l());
        LinearExpr rr = linear(b.r());
        if (l == null || rr == null) yield null;
        yield l.add(rr);
      }
      case Sub -> {
        LinearExpr l = linear(b.l());
        LinearExpr rr = linear(b.r());
        if (l == null || rr == null) yield null;
        yield l.sub(rr);
      }
      default -> yield null;
    }
  }
  default -> null;
 };
}

static Interval rvalInterval(RVal r, Map<String, Interval> box) {
 return switch (r) {
  case RVal.IntConst c -> Interval.of(c.v(), c.v());
  case LVal.Local l -> box.getOrDefault(l.name(), Interval.TOP);
  case LVal.StaticField f -> {
    BigInteger v = staticConst(f);
    yield v == null ? Interval.TOP : Interval.of(v, v);
  }
  case RVal.Binop b -> {
    Interval l = rvalInterval(b.l(), box);
    Interval rr = rvalInterval(b.r(), box);
    if (l.empty || rr.empty) yield Interval.EMPTY;
    if (b.op() == BinOp.Mult || b.op() == BinOp.Add || b.op() == BinOp.Sub) {
      yield switch (b.op()) {
        case Mult -> Interval.mul(l, rr);
        case Add -> Interval.add(l, rr);
        case Sub -> Interval.sub(l, rr);
        default -> Interval.TOP;
      };
    }
    if (!opPossible(b.op(), l, rr)) yield Interval.EMPTY;
    yield Interval.of(ZERO, ONE);
  }
  default -> Interval.TOP;
 };
}

        static Interval mul(Interval a, Interval b) {
            if (a.empty || b.empty) return EMPTY;
            if (a.isZero() || b.isZero()) return ZERO_INTERVAL;

            List<BigInteger> finite = new ArrayList<>();
            if (a.lo != null) {
                if (b.lo != null) finite.add(a.lo.multiply(b.lo));
                if (b.hi != null) finite.add(a.lo.multiply(b.hi));
            }
            if (a.hi != null) {
                if (b.lo != null) finite.add(a.hi.multiply(b.lo));
                if (b.hi != null) finite.add(a.hi.multiply(b.hi));
            }

            boolean aUnboundedBelow = a.lo == null;
            boolean aUnboundedAbove = a.hi == null;
            boolean bUnboundedBelow = b.lo == null;
            boolean bUnboundedAbove = b.hi == null;

            boolean aNeg = containsNegative(a);
            boolean aPos = containsPositive(a);
            boolean bNeg = containsNegative(b);
            boolean bPos = containsPositive(b);

            boolean unboundedBelow = (aUnboundedBelow && bPos) || (aUnboundedAbove && bNeg) || (bUnboundedBelow && aPos) || (bUnboundedAbove && aNeg);
            boolean unboundedAbove = (aUnboundedBelow && bNeg) || (aUnboundedAbove && bPos) || (bUnboundedBelow && aNeg) || (bUnboundedAbove && aPos);

            BigInteger lo = unboundedBelow ? null : (finite.isEmpty() ? null : Collections.min(finite));
            BigInteger hi = unboundedAbove ? null : (finite.isEmpty() ? null : Collections.max(finite));
            return of(lo, hi);
        }
